results.title: Canada vs Qatar: World Cup Group B Preview & Prediction | Odds2Win
highlights:
Co-hosts Canada and Qatar face off at the BC Place in Vancouver for a decisive Group B encounter during the second round of the 2026 World Cup. Playing on home soil gives the Canadians a massive crowd advantage, fundamentally shifting the tactical dynamics in favor of the North American side. The stakes are sky-high following the opening round. Canada earned a hard-fought 1-1 draw against Bosnia & Herzegovina, while Qatar collapsed to a 2-0 defeat against Switzerland. Now, Jesse Marsch's men need all three points to close in on a knockout spot, whereas Qatar must find a way to avoid consecutive defeats that would end their World Cup ambitions. Strategically, this clash pits Canada's relentless, high-energy wing play against Qatar's deep defensive structure.
[...]

After a left hamstring injury sustained with Bayern Munich ruled the superstar out of the tournament opener, the medical staff has been working overtime to clear him for this specific matchday.
